visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md patterns, built from components/site/v3. No KB-era mockup — the pattern set is the target (same basis as every post-2026-08-27 page).
competitiveTarget: No Central Oregon brokerage has an investor destination at all — competitors bury multi-family in a search filter. This page wins by honesty: the composition of the income market stated as a finding in the first line, live per-type counts with the Market Truth trace, this week's published 30-year fixed beside the calculators, and NO cash-flow promise. The rent side of an investor's math has no live source on this site — the only rent-bearing table is per-listing, frozen at a 2026-08-03 batch and walled behind admin auth — so the page publishes no rent, no yield and no DSCR, and hands the reader a calculator for the number only they know.
note: Matt ruling 2026-09-01 (decisions.md): investor becomes a real job with /invest as the door and the listing-page investor lens as the depth layer. Every inventory figure is a getPublicPlaceSegments region row — the same numbers the housing-market and search pages print (one source, §0). Stale internal analysis figures are never republished here. Capture is the income-property alert (multi-family pin — a narrowing filter). Detached/SFR is deliberately absent: that is the buyer story. SITE-50 (2026-09-09) replaced the Quiet #place opening — two prose blocks headed 'What this page is' and 'How to underwrite here', which the taste table scored 25 and called a cover memo — with a V3Pulse band whose claim IS the page's H1 and whose four rules are the largest income populations drawn as a part-to-whole, lit one at a time by the native radio switch. V3Instrument left the page in the same change: at region grain the metric layer withholds medianList and monthsOfSupply for every income segment, so the Instrument's only two figures were the multi-family and commercial ACTIVE COUNTS, which the Pulse above it now prints — an Instrument whose whole content is two numbers the section above already said is the repeated fact TASTE.md bans. The three remaining data families are split one per section: Pulse takes the active counts and their shares, Ledger takes the doors and how each type trades, Quiet #tools takes this week's published 30-year fixed. The rental-analysis sentence was cut, not reworded: RentalAnalysis.tsx and lib/hud-fmr.ts were deleted on 2026-09-09 (545e4e50), so the page had been advertising a surface the site no longer has.

requiredComponents.name: V3Ledger
requiredComponents.section: #searches — crawlable doors. Live listing rows (price + address + facts) when the tile read published any; otherwise one door per income property type.

requiredComponents.name: V3Quiet
